skills.name: Evidence-led delivery loop — Sahni adaptation
skills.description: Plan, produce and review a defined deliverable against observable acceptance conditions. Use for multi-step client or internal work; keep narrow edits and simple questions proportionate.

skills.name: Durable context handoff — Sahni adaptation
skills.description: Prepare durable context for resuming a long task or moving between Codex and Claude. Use at a session boundary, explicit handoff, meaningful checkpoint or demonstrated context conflict; not routine short replies.

skills.name: Decision review with distinct lenses — Sahni adaptation
skills.description: Pressure-test a consequential strategy, offer, operational choice or supplied creative asset. Use for genuine tradeoffs and critiques; not factual lookups, routine production or automatic five-agent debates.

skills.name: Careful file curation — Sahni adaptation
skills.description: Organise selected project files into a client-scoped reference library with copy verification, provenance and useful collections. Use for requested curation or folder organisation; not an automatic Mac-wide scan.

skills.name: Transcript-led video edit planning — Sahni adaptation
skills.description: Plan or review a talking-head footage edit using measured transcript timing, visual beats and captions. Use for supplied footage/transcript workflows; not generic AI-video generation or a claim that an unavailable renderer ran.

skills.name: Evidence-led operations briefing — Sahni adaptation
skills.description: Prepare a scoped operational brief from saved tasks, meetings, client requests or financial-document status. Use for requested daily/weekly summaries and administration; no recurring schedule or outbound action is implied.
